name: Pilot Bellowfiz
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz keeps a dwarven siege engine ready for battle. Known as “Fizzer,” he belongs to the Ironforge Siege Brigade and tends Jetsteam.

sections.title: Master of the Jetsteam
sections.body: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz keeps Jetsteam ready for battle. The depot lies just outside Ironforge, where he tends the heavy war machine he pilots. He tunes its parts and gathers what it needs for the field. Fellow driver Pilot Stonegear joins him in talk of vehicle designs, armor plating, and engine output. Their work keeps the mountain kingdom's mechanized strength ready across Khaz Modan.

faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz serves in the Ironforge Siege Brigade. At Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, he maintains and operates heavy siege engines for Khaz Modan's defense.

aliases: what siege engine does bellowfiz pilot
faq.answer: Bellowfiz pilots a dwarven siege engine named Jetsteam. Before a long Siege Brigade journey, he stocks it with a month's supplies, including boar meat and bear fur. He keeps Rejold Barleybrew's Evershine on hand to throw into its furnace for a burst of power.

faq.q: Where can Pilot Bellowfiz be found?
faq.answer: You can find Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, down the road east of Kharanos. The depot is an engineering and staging yard.

faq.q: What does he do with Pilot Stonegear?
faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz and Pilot Stonegear are fellow Siege Brigade drivers. When they are not tending their vehicles, they banter and debate siege engine design, armor, and mechanics.

angles.text: As a dwarf or gnome tinkerer, you can see field engineering in Bellowfiz's work: he keeps powerful siege engines running in freezing mountain weather.
As a dwarf, you can take pride in Ironforge's mechanized brigades and the engineering skill and heavy firepower guarding Khaz Modan.
